analysis.headline: @demo_roast_theory gets more views from fewer followers because its Reels open with a problem, not the brand.

working.evidence: Reels of 15 to 30 seconds reach 2.0× its typical post.

working.claim: They probably work because viewers immediately see a problem of their own.
working.evidence: Winning hooks name a mistake or ask a question in the first line.

not_working.evidence: Reels over 60 seconds reach 0.8× its typical post.

not_working.claim: They likely lose viewers because they begin with the company rather than the viewer.
